_comment: Machine-checkable pin for the vendored easy1staking-com/fn-bafin-cardano-sc tree.
The tree below is a VERBATIM copy of the upstream repository at `commit`.
Do not hand-edit any file in this directory. If upstream must be updated,
re-vendor from the new SHA and regenerate this manifest with
SecurityTokenUpstreamPinTest (offline) enforces every hash below plus the
byte-equality of the backend's resource copy of plutus.json;
verify-upstream-pin.sh (online) re-downloads the pinned tarball and diffs.

to the easy1staking-com fork, whose `fix/cmta-requirements-fixes` branch merges
FluidTokens:main and fixes the three defects documented in
positional rather than identity/index-addressed node lookup; no registration
mode on the minting-logic withdraw redeemer). The SHA is pinned, not the branch.
blueprint_reproduced_note: Rebuilt from the vendored sources with aiken v1.1.23+8949565 (the exact compiler recorded in the committed plutus.json preamble): all 21 validators' compiledCode came back byte-identical, so the committed blueprint is not stale against its sources.

excluded_from_vendoring.README.md: Upstream's README is intentionally NOT vendored: this repository does not carry markdown files under src/substandards/. It is documentation only and affects no compiled artifact. It is excluded from the diff in verify-upstream-pin.sh and absent from `files` below, so re-adding it makes SecurityTokenUpstreamPinTest fail with UNEXPECTED README.md. Every other upstream file is vendored verbatim with no exclusions.
